name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_unadvise_and_release
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload::UnadviseAndRelease unadvises the download event-sink connection point using the stored cookie, then releases the standalone download COM object.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The download COM object's Release call remains modeled through the imported/provider COM vtable contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x4422f0 validates the no-argument helper shape, zCom::ConnectionPointContainer_Unadvise call with g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload, g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink_IID, and g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadAdviseCookie, followed by a COM Release dispatch through vtable offset 0x08 on g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownload with the Release return value left in EAX.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_unadvise_release_smoke verifies the unadvise connection-point lookup, IID match, stored cookie propagation, transient provider releases, final download object Release call, and returned Release value.
